action_types.inspection: Visual, detailed, special-detailed, or other inspection.
action_types.test_or_check: Functional test, operational test, measurement, or check.
action_types.remove: Removal of a component, part, or material.
action_types.install: Installation of a component, part, placard, software, or other item.
action_types.replacement: Replacement of an affected item with another item.
action_types.modification: Configuration change or embodiment of a modification.
action_types.repair: Restoration using an approved repair instruction.
action_types.rework: Rework that is distinct from a general repair or modification.
action_types.adjust: Adjustment, rigging, torque, calibration, or setting change.
action_types.limitation: New or changed airworthiness, maintenance, or operating limitation.
action_types.operational_procedure: Mandatory flight crew or operational procedure.
action_types.document_amendment: Revision of an AMP, AFM, ALS, MEL, manual, or records.
action_types.reporting: Reporting results or findings to an authority or approval holder.
action_types.records_review: Review of maintenance, delivery, or configuration records.
action_types.prohibition: Prohibition on operation, installation, or further use.
action_types.lubrication: Lubrication or application of a specified substance.
action_types.cleaning: Cleaning, removal of contamination, or surface preparation.
action_types.contact_manufacturer: Mandatory contact for approved instructions or disposition.
action_types.other: Mandated action that cannot be represented by another label. Explain in notes.

compliance_logic.all: Every listed limit must be satisfied.
compliance_logic.conditional: The controlling limit depends on an explicit condition.

compliance_units.landing: Landings when explicitly used instead of cycles.
compliance_units.before_next_flight: Categorical event; do not convert to zero time.
compliance_units.other: Another explicitly stated unit retained in raw_value.

easa_sections.cover: AD number, dates, approval holder, TCDS, foreign AD, supersedure, ATA and subject.
easa_sections.applicability: Aircraft, model, serial number, part, modification, STC, and configuration scope.
easa_sections.definitions: Terms explicitly defined by the AD.
easa_sections.reason: Events, defect, cause, unsafe condition, consequence, and regulatory rationale.
easa_sections.required_actions_and_compliance_times: Mandatory actions and their linked timing requirements.
easa_sections.compliance: Legacy-form compliance section when actions and timing are combined.
easa_sections.reference_publications: Service Bulletins and other referenced publications.
easa_sections.remarks: AMOC authority, consultation history, and contact information.
easa_sections.appendix: Appendix content outside the main sections.
easa_sections.table: Evidence whose meaning depends on table headers or footnotes.
easa_sections.other: A source section not covered above. Preserve section_raw.

relationship_types.supersedes: The current AD explicitly supersedes the target AD.
relationship_types.superseded_by: The current AD explicitly states that the target AD supersedes it.
relationship_types.revises: The current AD is a later revision in the same AD-number family.
relationship_types.revised_by: The target AD is a later revision in the same family.
relationship_types.corrects: The current publication corrects the target publication without changing its AD number.
relationship_types.corrected_by: The target publication corrects the current publication.
relationship_types.cancels: The current AD explicitly cancels the target AD.
relationship_types.cancelled_by: The target AD explicitly cancels the current AD.
relationship_types.replaces: The document explicitly uses replaces and the direction is unambiguous.
relationship_types.retains_requirements_of: The current AD explicitly retains requirements from the target AD.
relationship_types.related: A human-verified relationship not represented elsewhere.
relationship_types.referenced_only: Historical or contextual mention; never treat this as supersedure.

field_states.present: The field is stated and legible.
field_states.explicit_none: The source explicitly says none or not applicable.
field_states.not_stated: The source does not state the field.
field_states.illegible: The field appears present but cannot be read reliably.
field_states.ambiguous: Two or more interpretations remain possible.
field_states.conflicting: Source passages conflict and require adjudication.

quality_flags.header_filename_mismatch: The authoritative cover-page AD number and filename differ.
quality_flags.ocr_required: Native extraction is insufficient for annotation.
quality_flags.ocr_uncertain: OCR text remains uncertain after review.
quality_flags.visual_transcription_used: Evidence was transcribed from the rendered PDF.
quality_flags.complex_table: Applicability or compliance meaning depends on a complex table.
quality_flags.cross_page_clause: A single clause continues across pages.
quality_flags.complex_applicability: Applicability contains nested conditions, exclusions, or multiple groups.
quality_flags.complex_compliance: Compliance has alternative limits, branches, or table-driven timing.
quality_flags.ambiguous_relationship: Relationship direction or target is unclear.
quality_flags.source_conflict: Rendered source, extracted text, metadata, or repeated passages conflict.
quality_flags.missing_required_action: A draft record has no usable mandatory action.
quality_flags.manual_review_required: A human reviewer must resolve another issue described in notes.
